_comment: USD per million tokens. Verified against https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing. Update this file when pricing changes or a new model enters the pipeline; token_report.py reads it at runtime — never hardcode a price in code.
_note: cache_write_5m/1h = 5-minute/1-hour prompt cache write multipliers (1.25x/2x base input); cache_read = cache hit rate (0.1x base input, same regardless of write duration). token_ledger.py currently logs a single cache_creation_input_tokens figure without distinguishing 5m vs 1h — token_report.py defaults to the 5-minute rate (the common case) until the ledger captures duration.
